resources.string: Fast push (own service, experimental)
List changes within a minute through a small service your household runs. Off by default.
Fast push
Demo mode has no server, so there is nothing to push. Connect a Tandoor to use fast push.
Guests cannot use fast push. Ask the household\'s administrator for a member account.
Log in to a Tandoor first.
Experimental, and not needed

Without it Tandem checks the list in the background as usual. With it, a small push service your household runs itself checks the shopping list and wakes this phone through a UnifiedPush app (for example ntfy), so a change shows up within a minute even when Tandem is closed.

When turning on, Tandem sends its Tandoor token to the service once, so the service can check that you belong to its household; the service does not keep it. A wake-up only says \"sync now\": what changed is read by Tandem itself.
